main_text.p: hos Iudæi Nazarenos appellant per eum. Nam & fumus de quibus scriptum est, Nazaræi exalbati sunt super niuem, qui scilicet retro lurida- ti delinquentiæ maculis, & nigrati ignorantiæ tenebris. Chrifto autem appellatio Nazaræi competitura erat ex infantiæ latebris, in quas apud Nazareth defcendit vitando Archelaum filium Herodis. Hactenus ille. Chriftus igitur Nazaræus vel potius Nazarenus, id est, Naζωραῖος fuit, Actor. 2. verfu 22:3. verfu 6.Ioann. 19.verfu 19. Matth.2. verfu 23.A Chrifto autem Nazareno Chriftiani primum Nazareni dicti, vt apparet ex Actor.24. verfu 5. & ex fuperiore Tertulliani loco, itemque Epiphanio. Nam primum omnium μαθηταί, postea Ναζωραῖοι, demum Antiochiæ Χριστιανοί sunt appeliati, qui Euangelicam fidem & doctrinam profitebantur. Hoc Nazaræorum nomen in probro fuit, non honori inter infideles, vti appellatio Galilæorum postea temporibus Iuliani apostatæ imperatoris, Ioann. 1. verfu 47. & Sarmentariorum & Exorciftarum, quibus nominibus igno-miniosè vocabantur ab ethnicis Christiani. Inter fideles autem laudi ducebatur, primis illis Chriftianismi temporibus. Ex quo factum est, vt hæretici, de quibus nunc agitur, fallaciofa oftentatione se Nazaræos appellarent, licet a vera Christi doctrina defciuiffent. Quanquam vero ignorare se fatetur Epiphanius, quo potisimum tempore extiterint, vtrum ante Cerinthianos, vel postea: tamen alibi idem scribit tunc primum innotuisse atque apparuisse, cum Christiani diuinitus admoniti omnes

page.notes: Greek words in the text (μαθηταί, Ναζωραῖοι, Χριστιανοί, Naζωραῖος) are reproduced from the scan as best legible; the Greek on the scan is partly blurred. Χριστιανοί and Ναζωραῖοι should be checked against the original. Word "Nazarenus," and "Naζωραῖος" line: the Greek word is partly obscured. Also "Antiochiæ" line, Greek word "Χριστιανοί" and "μαθηταί" are approximations. Some letters in the scan are faint or smudged; "fallaciosa" is my reading of a word near "ftuofa" and is marked for review. Lower part of the page is faint near "omnes" and a small mark below it is not text. Chrifto/Christi spellings follow the print. Marginal reference numbers in the text (Actor. 2, Ioann. 19, Matth. 2) are printed in the body and kept as they stand.
